description: A bill moving through the North Carolina General Assembly could help folks who have needed an amputation get moving again. The legislation was inspired by the experience of one North Carolina native.Reagan Perry of Raleigh is always on the go.“I don’t think people realize how much you move around in a day until you have that ability taken from you,” Perry said.But in the last eight years, how she moves has changed.
